login.title: Welcome to {name}
login.subtitle: Log in or create an account in one step — no password needed.
login.dialogSubtitle: One tap with Google or Apple, or a code to your phone.
login.consent: By continuing, you agree to our <terms>Terms of use</terms> and confirm that you have read our <privacy>Privacy policy</privacy>.

phone.label: Phone number
phone.hintWhatsapp: We'll send you a 6-digit code on WhatsApp.
phone.codeSentSms: We sent a code by SMS to <ltr>{phone}</ltr>.
phone.codeSentWhatsapp: We sent a code on WhatsApp to <ltr>{phone}</ltr>.
phone.resendIn: You can ask for a new code in <ltr>{time}</ltr>
phone.resent: A new code is on its way.

twoFactor.title: 2-step login
twoFactor.subtitle: Open your authenticator app and enter the 6-digit code for {name}.
twoFactor.instructions: Your account is protected with 2-step login. Enter the code from your authenticator app.
twoFactor.help: No access to your app? Write to us at <link>{email}</link>

setup.title: Turn on 2-step login
setup.subtitle: Extra protection for your account: each time you log in, we'll also ask for a code from an authenticator app such as Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator or 1Password.
setup.staffRequired: Staff accounts must turn on 2-step login before opening the admin panel.
setup.step1: Install an authenticator app on your phone.
setup.step2: Scan this QR code with the app.
setup.step3: Enter the 6-digit code the app shows.
setup.qrAlt: QR code for your authenticator app
setup.manualKey: Can't scan it? Enter this key by hand:
setup.loadFailed: We couldn't prepare the QR code
setup.enabledText: From now on, we'll ask for a code from your app each time you log in.
setup.alreadyEnabled: 2-step login is already on for your account.

settings.title: 2-step login
settings.descriptionOff: An extra layer of protection: a code from an authenticator app each time you log in.
settings.descriptionOn: We ask for a code from your authenticator app each time you log in.
settings.disableText: To confirm, enter a current code from your authenticator app.
settings.staffNote: Required for staff accounts — it can't be turned off.

verifyPhone.title: Add your phone number
verifyPhone.subtitle: Required to post a listing. We'll send a code to make sure the number is yours.
verifyPhone.reasonTrust: A verified number helps guests trust your listings.
verifyPhone.reasonContact: So guests can reach you by phone or WhatsApp.
verifyPhone.reasonPrivate: We never show it publicly. Contact details are only shown to logged-in users who tap “Show contact”.

errors.invalid_code: That code isn't right. Check it and try again.
errors.code_expired: This code has expired. Ask for a new one.
errors.too_many_attempts: Too many wrong codes. Ask for a new code.
errors.invalid_phone: This phone number doesn't look right. Check the number and the country code.
errors.country_not_supported: We can't send codes to this country yet. You can log in with Google or Apple instead.
errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Please wait a few minutes and try again.
errors.phone_taken: This number already belongs to another account. Log in with it, or use a different number.
errors.captcha_failed: We couldn't confirm that you're not a robot. Refresh the page and try again.
errors.account_suspended: This account is suspended. If you think this is a mistake, contact support.
errors.account_banned: This account is blocked. If you think this is a mistake, contact support.
errors.two_factor_required: Enter the code from your authenticator app first, then try again.
errors.sms_unavailable: We couldn't send the code right now. Try again in a minute, or log in with Google or Apple.
errors.oauth_failed: Logging in didn't work. Please try again.
errors.network: No connection. Check your internet and try again.
errors.unknown: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.totp_invalid_code: That code isn't right. Enter the current code from your app.
errors.totp_setup_expired: Setup took too long. We've made a new QR code — please scan it again.
errors.totp_required_for_staff: Staff accounts must keep 2-step login on.
errors.server_error: Something went wrong on our side. Please try again.
errors.invalid_input: Check the details and try again.
errors.forbidden: You don't have permission to do this.
